defects.what: The page holds 1 pupil problem(s) (Score /1) beside one worked example: a lone item on an A4 page, the owner's original complaint class.
defects.fix: Page side-by-side pairs by their own heights and never let one tall twin take a whole page: shrink the twin to its content (steps under, one state), or fall back to the compact band above the problems when a pair cannot share the page with another.

defects.what: Anchor eligibility is decided from the FIRST generated candidate only (print-sheet.js anchorSet: `if (eligible === null) eligible = anchorEligible(it); if (!eligible) return;`). When that candidate is a multiple-choice variant the whole sheet gets no anchor and the note falsely says the skill "has no step-by-step steps yet"; when it is eligible, later multiple-choice candidates are accepted as worked examples.
defects.fix: Test anchorEligible on every candidate and skip ineligible ones; only give up after ANCHOR_MAX tries.

defects.what: The worked example is a "Circle ALL sums that equal 1." multi-select item whose printed answer is "Answer: opt3" — an internal option id, with no steps and no Say line.
defects.fix: Never pick a choice / sort variant as an anchor (anchorEligible per candidate); print choices by their label, never their id.

defects.what: Independent prints NO worked example at all (anchors requested); the note says the skill "has no step-by-step steps yet", which is false (its provider implements workedSteps and More Practice draws one).
defects.fix: Per-candidate eligibility in anchorSet.

defects.what: Slash fractions in print: steps "1/2 + 1/2 = 2/2", "5/4 = 1 1/4", Say "1 1/2 plus 1 1/2 is 3", and the choice options "2/8 + 1/8" wrapped over two lines (ws-print-lint L-FONT TY-7 x10).
defects.fix: Stacked fractions in step text and options (TY-7).
